content: I hate this mode with a burning passion
They intend to stop update indefinitely or just freeze for time being? I read this as future content added later which I'm fine with.
I think there is a good amount of creativity in current meta (except GLotan zzz)
We had a discussion about it and while I had assumed that too at first. Light had once said  that divine realm won't be the norm and look where we are at now
I fear I recall when that happened as well. Ah I hope that is not the casee

And OthersTM like cores got enforced nonetheless, corpo-horla-wheel intetaction got nerfed after 1y of interaction going well (and people had reported it before, just in case!), etc

So I personally lost a little faith in light
But I'm still hoping I'm wrong bc I love traphase
its okay i'll ask nicely not to lose our beloved game mode

Has Caraboo been added to Traphase yet?
Last time I checked she wasnt
If not, is there a reason for her not to be added?
they said that they were going to stop adding new characters/wheels for a while
so that they could "focus on balancing what is currently available in traphase"
but I haven't seen any of those balance changes either

that on top of hearing that all future new characters will be divine realm kinda peeved me so I've decided I'm putting the game down for now, I had some good times and I enjoy the story so I might come back and catch up eventually, but I just don't feel like doing regular upkeep for the game rn
